domain-information: A manager meets with a client to understand the organization’s current challenges.
A manager assigns a consultant team to a new consulting project.
A manager reviews the project progress reports submitted by consultants.
A consultant prepares a proposal outlining improvement strategies and expected outcomes.
A consultant presents the proposal containing an engagement plan to the client.
A consultant updates the manager on the state of the project in a progress report.
A consultant collaborates with an employee in an analysis session to collect data and perform analysis.
A reporter gathers data from the client's organization.
A reporter creates data reports that summarize project findings for client presentations.
A reporter presents his findings in an analysis session.
A client reviews the consulting proposal and approves the recommended engagement plan.
A client provides feedback on the consultant’s recommendations after implementation.
A client requests a follow-up meeting with the manager to discuss further collaboration opportunities.

domain objects.name: Manager
domain objects.description: Oversees consulting projects and manages relationships with clients.

domain objects.name: Organization
domain objects.description: The client’s company or institution being analyzed.

domain objects.name: Consulting Project
domain objects.description: Engagement between consultants and client to deliver improvements.

domain objects.name: Consultant
domain objects.description: Provides professional advice and creates project proposals.

domain objects.name: Progress Report
domain objects.description: Summary of project status and progress submitted to the manager.

domain objects.name: Proposal
domain objects.description: Document outlining improvement strategies and an engagement plan.

domain objects.name: Engagement Plan
domain objects.description: Detailed plan describing project scope, deliverables, and timeline.

domain objects.name: Analysis Session
domain objects.description: Collaborative meeting where data is reviewed and discussed.

domain objects.name: Reporter
domain objects.description: Collects and analyzes data to support consulting recommendations.

domain objects.name: Data Report
domain objects.description: Report summarizing data analysis and findings for client presentations.

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: Client’s evaluation of consulting outcomes and recommendations.

domain objects.name: Follow Up Meeting
domain objects.description: Meeting between manager and client to discuss future collaboration.

associations.description: Manager meets Client to understand organizational challenges.
Manager assigns Consulting Project to consultant team.
Client requests Follow Up Meeting to explore new opportunities.
Manager attends Follow Up Meeting with Client to plan next steps.
Consultant prepares Proposal with improvement strategies.
Client reviews and approves the Consultant’s Proposal.
Client provides Feedback on implemented recommendations.
Feedback is shared with Consultant for evaluation.
Consultant submits Progress Report to Manager.
Manager reviews the received Progress Report.
Consultant leads Analysis Session to discuss findings.
Reporter collects data from Client’s Organization.
Reporter compiles findings into a Data Report.
Reporter presents data in an Analysis Session.
